english.name: Ajloun Forest Reserve
english.description:
Ajloun Forest Reserve offers a woodland visit in the northern Jordanian highlands. Evergreen oak and other Mediterranean trees shelter wildlife, while walking routes introduce the reserve's landscape and nearby rural communities. RSCN manages the reserve, and UNESCO's biosphere programme records the wider Ajloun designation in 2025.

Walk beneath evergreen oak trees and pause at forest viewpoints. Bring drinking water and shoes with good grip; keep to marked paths.

english.name: As-Salt Historic Centre
english.description:
As-Salt's historic centre brings together yellow-limestone buildings, connected stairways, narrow lanes and public spaces on steep hills. Its late-Ottoman growth as a trading town shaped an architecture and urban culture recognised by UNESCO when the property was inscribed in 2021. The listing highlights both the built environment and traditions of hospitality and cooperation among Muslim and Christian communities.

Explore the yellow-stone streets, shopfronts and hillside stairs. Leave space for residents and ask permission before photographing people.

Mujib Biosphere Reserve protects a striking transition between the Dead Sea shore and the surrounding mountain country. Its valleys, cliffs and river habitats support a varied natural landscape. A visit to the reserve is not one interchangeable activity: water routes and dry-land hikes have different seasons, requirements and booking arrangements.

english.name: Dana Biosphere Reserve
english.description:
Dana Biosphere Reserve spans mountain slopes and deep valleys towards Wadi Araba, bringing together markedly different habitats in a compact landscape. Managed by RSCN, it combines biodiversity conservation with nature tourism and local livelihoods. Dana village offers a cultural introduction through its older buildings, terraced gardens and craft activity, while the reserve's walking routes reach very different terrain.

Enjoy village views and a selected reserve trail rather than attempting every route. Carry water, sun protection and a warm layer for changing mountain weather.

Iraq Al-Amir offers a heritage visit southwest of Amman, where olive-growing countryside, hillside caves and ancient stone architecture form a different setting from the city centre. The Jordan Tourism Board identifies nearby Qasr El-Abd as a rare surviving example of pre-Roman architecture in Jordan, dating to the second century BCE. Combine Qasr Al-Abd with the surrounding village landscape. Stay clear of fragile masonry and keep entrances and farm access routes unobstructed.

Petra brings together Nabataean engineering, carved sandstone façades and the remains of an ancient caravan city. The Siq leads towards the Treasury, while tombs, streets and the Monastery reveal a much larger landscape than a single monument. Its water-management works help explain how settlement flourished in this setting.

english.name: St. George’s Church (Madaba Map)

english.name: Um er-Rasas (Kastrom Mefa’a)
english.description:
Um er-Rasas preserves an archaeological landscape shaped by Roman, Byzantine and early Islamic occupation. The mosaics of St Stephen’s Church are a principal highlight, while church remains and the distinctive stylite towers reveal different aspects of religious life. UNESCO recognises the site’s exceptional heritage.

english.name: Azraq Wetland Reserve
english.description:
Azraq Wetland Reserve protects an oasis ecosystem in Jordan’s eastern desert. Established by RSCN in 1978, it is an important place to understand wetland conservation and the movements of migratory birds. Water, vegetation and desert surroundings create a landscape unlike the country’s highland reserves.

Move quietly along the wetland route and pause at observation points. Wildlife sightings vary; binoculars and patience help without disturbing birds.

رسوم الدخول: للأردنيين 0 د.أ.؛ للزوار الدوليين 5 د.أ.؛ للأطفال 0 د.أ.
ميزانية اليوم: 10–25 د.أ. للشخص وتشمل الدخول ووجبة بسيطة؛ لا تشمل النقل بين المدن والأنشطة الإرشادية الإضافية.
الوصول: استخدم نقطة الخريطة للاستدلال على المنطقة؛ فهي ليست مدخلاً ممسوحاً. المواقف: مواقف للزوار قرب نقطة الوصول الإرشادية.
الوصول والصعوبة: مشي طويل ومنحدرات وأدراج. متوسط إلى شاق.
المرافق: منطقة استقبال ودورات مياه عند نقطة البدء؛ مرافق محدودة على المسارات. الطعام والشراب: احمل الماء والوجبات الخفيفة وزجاجة قابلة للتعبئة.
الحجز: خطّط لزيارة مستقلة ورتّب مساعدة المجموعات مسبقاً. إرشادات المجموعة: للعائلات والأصدقاء؛ راقب الأطفال وعدّل المسار بحسب الحاجة.
الجدول: يومياً، بما في ذلك الجمعة والسبت؛ 06:30–17:00. التخطيط الموسمي: آذار ونيسان؛ تشرين الأول وتشرين الثاني. أفضل وقت خلال اليوم: الصباح الباكر.
اقتراحات قريبة: البترا؛ قلعة الشوبك.

english.name: Aqaba Marine Reserve
english.description:
Aqaba Marine Reserve protects a Red Sea landscape of coral reefs, seagrass and deeper reef habitats. UNESCO inscribed the property in 2026, recognising its ecological importance. It is a managed conservation area, not a single beach with one universal visitor entrance.

Enjoy the coast and arrange any water activity with a licensed operator. Never stand on coral, collect marine life or enter restricted zones; observe lifeguard and weather guidance.
english.address: Aqaba South Coast, Aqaba, Jordan. Geographic arrival reference near Aqaba Marine Reserve.
english.transportation_notes: Car or taxi to the south-coast visitor area
english.activities:
Learn about coral and seagrass conservation
Consider permitted snorkelling or diving only after access is confirmed

arabic.name: محمية العقبة البحرية
arabic.description:
تحمي محمية العقبة البحرية مشهداً من الشعاب المرجانية ومروج الأعشاب البحرية وموائل شعابية أعمق في البحر الأحمر. وقد أدرجتها اليونسكو عام 2026 تقديراً لأهميتها البيئية. وهي منطقة حفظ منظمة، وليست شاطئاً واحداً له مدخل موحد لجميع الزوار.

استمتع بالساحل ورتّب الأنشطة المائية مع مشغّل مرخّص. لا تقف على المرجان ولا تجمع الكائنات البحرية أو تدخل المناطق المحظورة، والتزم بإرشادات الإنقاذ والطقس.
